verdict.rationale: Poly ships its own built-in agent. It sees the current file or folder, can summarize, explain and edit files, and handles multi-step tasks such as extracting invoice data into a CSV. It can also spawn subagents, and its edits are preserved in version history for rollback. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, since all evidence is vendor documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Poly agent can handle tasks that span multiple steps — reading, searching, writing, and organizing — in a single request.
The agent sees what you see, so you can ask it about the file you're reading, or the folder you're browsing. Ask it to summarize, explain, or even edit your files.
Automate tasks like organizing a folder.
The Poly agent can write and edit files directly in your storage.
Your agent can spawn its own subagents, assign them tasks, and track their progress.
The original version is preserved in version history, so you can roll back if needed.
